=== Description===

A very simplistic and small template that shows in-game dye colors in a small box.

=== Usage ===
<nowiki>{{dyecolor|HTML color name OR hex value}}</nowiki><br>
For example, <nowiki>{{dyecolor|green}}</nowiki> will output the following...<br>
'''Note:''' If using a hex color value, the # symbol ''must'' be included.
=== Output===
{{dyecolor|green}}
